$Comment: How a Lootable reward READS where a screen shows it before it pays out. A lootable names a
loot table that is only ROLLED at the moment it is handed over, so no specific item can be
promised ahead of time. The reward reads as its table: the table's own name on the line, and
hovering the chest shows that name and what the table pays (the table file's Text,
ListContents and PlainBundle say how; a roll setting HideInPreview stays out of that list,
which then ends saying a few more rare finds are left unsaid).
This file is presentation only: it names no Command, so the built-in Lootable handler keeps
the payout, and nothing here changes what is rolled.
NameKey - the label of a lootable whose table is set to PlainBundle, or names no table this
server has ('Loot Bundle'), shipped by this library in every locale it carries.
